q80.interaction_unresolved_rule: For sparse L<d keep the actual nonzero target error and accuracy_goal_met false. Algebraic A_L=0 is a separate underresolution-control check, not an accuracy pass.

reference.gaussian_finite_width: bounded by the explicit continuous-tail enclosure; not a point oracle
reference.independent_rounding: Directed Decimal interval operations plus explicitly bounded alternating/Taylor remainders, not precision agreement alone

failure_policy: Any mandatory structural/reference/required accuracy check false makes the case false. Row study outcomes and baseline estimated-convergence flags are retained separately; no fixed-false reporting mask. No postmeasurement relaxation.
